steps: Boil the potato and beetroot in water on medium heat until a knife slides in easily but they are not mushy. Cool and peel them.
Blend the coriander, mint, green chilli, garlic, a pinch of the cumin, a pinch of salt and the lemon juice into a thick chutney.
Slice the potato, beetroot, cucumber, tomato and onion into thin rounds.
Spread soft butter on both slices of bread, then a layer of chutney on the buttered side.
Lay the potato on one slice and sprinkle it with chaat masala, the rest of the cumin, roasted and ground, and the rest of the salt.
Add the beetroot, cucumber, tomato and onion, with a little more masala between the layers.
Close with the second slice, chutney side down, and press gently.
Eat it fresh, or toast it on a tawa on medium heat or in a sandwich maker until golden.
note: I used chaat masala with roasted cumin in place of a separate sandwich masala, and made the chutney part of the dish so one sandwich is two slices of bread. Toasting is optional, as it is on the street.
